body: This is example at https://link-assistant.github.io/meta-expression/web ``` Elon Musk is alive ``` Is unknown. ``` this statement is false ``` is unknown And so on. Please read again the vision at, and make sure it real. It is not clear what level is. In any expression, there is always lots of implied statements. Like `1` means `single whole number quantinty` (or correct me), `+` means arithmetic operation, `1 + 1` depends on `+` operation being able to apply to numbers `1` and `1`, and so on. ``` Elon Musk ``` Should be interpreted to `Elon` is name, `Musk` is surname. Combined both mean `person named Elon Musk`. And for checking these facts we should actually lazely go to wikipedia/wikidata, and check for example if is stated that person is dead, if not - we should profide refutation. Also we should use never confidence in 0% and 100% about real facts, we should always keep some small probability that our knowledge or wikipedia knowledge is obsolote or wrong. And `1 + 1` = 2 only in context of classical arithmetics, if we redefine the belief/formal system we should be able change meanings of `1`, and `+`, and their combination, so we should be able to override data from wikipedia or wikidata. We also need configuration for basic user beliefs as contieous sliders like true/false/undefined wehre 0% is false and 100% is true and undefined or don't care, or don't know is 50%. So we clearly need a way have configurator bout basic beliefs, for the user, and it should be saved in localstorage. Also it should be easy to report issues on any page/any mode or on fail, that automatically prefills GitHub issue for the user in one click, like we do with https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator. Also as in https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator please make as much prepared examples as possible for user to see all posibilities of the system. Also we need support traversing wikipedia in worker thread for actually getting data to check confirmations and refutations. We also need to infer / calculate which statements can support or refute provided statement. Check how we use wikipedia API from the browser in https://github.com/link-assistant/human-language, but make sure we store everything in links notation in local storage (human readable), but actually work with the data in binary for using https://github.com/linksplatform/doublets-rs, and you can see example on how to support unicode strings inside links network storage in https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli, but we need reimplement in rust (using sequences of links, represented as tree of duplets, so each single link can represent single unicode character and more). `1 + 1` can be intepreted as a question expression `What is the result of arithmetic expression (1 + 1)?`, so we should support not only statements, but also questions. Continue to work on our vision, and make it as real as possible and as useful as possible. Make sure everything from all my issues reflected in the repository in as much detail as possible in all relevant parts. Try to work with my requirements in wider range predicting future potential issues, and solve them as soon as possible before they occur. We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).
title: Continue working on our vision
